soft_deny: Never apply a database migration (via exec_migration, a direct npx tsx script, or otherwise) without first checking lib/migration-status.ts for an existing registered entry for it

Never send a real SMS or WhatsApp message to a resident, owner, or board member without confirming with the user first
Never modify or delete a Supabase Storage bucket's configuration (e.g. allowedMimeTypes) without confirming with the user first
